verses.text: Syal Dios icha tik: Ab'ek ex anima kajan t'a sti' ha' mar, numan tzex aj t'a wichanh. Tek'b'ejek he b'a ex niwak chonhab', kotanhek, junnhej tzonh ajek. Ol ex lolonok, ol in lolonpax a in tik.

¿Mach ol ak'an cheklaj jun rey t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, jun ol ak'annhej ganar owal? ¿Mach ol ak'anoch niwak chonhab' t'a yol sk'ab', yik ol yak'anem sb'a heb' t'ay? Ha yet' yespada jun rey chi' yet' sjul-lab' ol saktzipanb'at heb' icha sb'at smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik'.
Ol el juntzanhxo heb' rey elelal t'a yichanh jun rey chi'. Palta tzalajk'olal ol b'atnhej, ichato manh ol em yok t'a sat lu'um.
¿Mach ol ak'an elk'och juntzanh tik? ¿Mach najinakelta masanil tastak ujinak t'a yichb'anel? Ha in ton Jehová in, a in in b'onak. Ha innhej Dios in, b'ab'el waj t'a smasanil, slajwub' in paxi.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar, ol yil heb', ol xiw heb' yilani. Masanil heb' kajan b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal yuj tas ol in k'ulej yet' jun rey chi', xchi Dios. Ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima.
Junjun heb' ol laj skuchb'ejkot sb'a, ol yak'an yip heb'.

Ha heb' jelan sb'oan yechel tastak, a heb' skuchb'an heb' smunlaj t'a k'een plata. Haxo heb' smunlaj t'a k'een martillo, a heb' skuchb'an heb' stenwi k'een t'a k'een tenlab', syalan heb': Te wach' k'een ko niplab' k'een tik, xchi heb'. Elanhchamel slawuxej juntzanh yechel chi' heb', yik stzatzb'i, yik max telwi.
Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, ab'ek tas swala': In chekab' wal eyaji, sik'b'il ex el wuuj, yinhtilal ex kan winh wamigo aj Abraham.
Ha in ton wik'nak ex kot b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ex wawtannakkot b'aj te najat eyajkanb'ati. Walannak t'ayex to in chekab' ex. Ha in in sik'nak ex eli, malaj b'aj tzex in patikejeli.
Manh ex xiwok, ayinek' heyet'ok. Manh ex och ilk'olal, yujto a in ton tik he Diosal in. Ha in swak' eyip, a in tzex in kolo'. Ha in tzex in yamoch waan yet' wip swak'lab'ej t'a tojolal.
Masanil heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayex, q'uixwelal ol ajkan heb', emnakilal ol ajkan heb'. Ha heb' tz'ak'an yip yak'an owal heyet'ok, ol satkanel heb'.
Olto he say heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, palta manhxo ol ilchaj heb' eyuuj. Ha heb' tz'ak'antaxon owal heyet'ok, ol kannhej heb' icha junok tas malajtaxoni.
Yujto a in Jehová in tik, he Diosal in. Ha in ix ex in ketz b'eyok. Ha in ton ix wal t'ayex: Manh ex xiwok, ol in och heyet'ok, xin chi.
Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, wach'chom kennhej he b'isul, malaj eyip, palta manh ex xiwok, ol in och heyet'ok. Ha in ton he Diosal in Ha inxonhej Ochi, he Kolumal in.
Ol ex wak'och icha junok k'een ik'umel sat trigo ak'to te ay ye. Ol laj he mak'poj lum niwak witz, pokok ol ajkan lum eyuuj. Ha lum tzalkixtak, chok' ol eyutejkan lum icha smatz'il ixim trigo.

Ol he tzipk'e lum t'a kal ik', haxo ik' chi' ol ik'anb'at lu'um. Ol saklemkanb'at lu'um yuj chakxuxum ik'. Yuj chi', ol ex tzalaj t'ayin Jehová in tik. Ol eyik'chaanh he b'a wuuj, a in ton he Diosal in Ha inxonhej Ochi.

Ha heb' anima meb'a' malaj tas ay t'ay, say ha ha' heb', max chaxlaj ha' yuj heb'. Wan scham heb' yuj takinhtial. Palta a inxo Jehová in tik, ol in kolwaj t'a heb', manh ol waktejkan heb' a in he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik.

Ha t'a lum jolomtak witz takinh sat, ol laj wak'k'eul a niwak ha' sb'eyi, haxo t'a snanhaltak lum ak'lik, ol laj k'eul sjaj ha' kotak ha'. Ha lum takinh sat, sitz'atak ol ajkan lu'um. Haxo t'a lum takinh lu'um, ol laj k'eul ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi.
Ha t'a lum takinh lum chi' ol wawej te' k'ute', te' akakia, te' arrayán yet' te' oliwo. Ha t'a lum takinh sat chi' ol wak' q'uib' te' k'ub'taj, te' taj yet' te' tzikap,
yik wach' syil masanil anima, snachajpaxel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová in ix in b'o juntzanh tik yet' in poder, a in he Diosal in, Ha inxonhej Ochi, a in ix in b'o'o.
Ha Jehová sReyal heb' yinhtilal Jacob, a tz'alan icha tik: Kotanhek ex komon Dios, ch'oxek he jelanil, ch'oxek tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a.
Kotanhek, ul alek t'ayonh tastak toto ol ujok. Alek t'ayonh tas syalelk'och tastak ujinakxo, ol ko cha kab'i, yik wach' ol kila' tas ol aj slajwielk'ochi.
Tato yel Dios ex, alek t'ayonh tas toto ol ujok chi', yik skojtakejeli to Dios ex. Ch'oxek wal kila' tas syal eyuuj chi', taxonhej wach', ma chuk, yik sat ko k'ool kilani, yik tzonh xiwk'ei.
Palta a ex wal tik, b'alaj malaj jab'ok eyelk'ochi, malaj tas syal eyuuj. Ha heb' syak'em sb'a t'ayex, patikab'ilel heb'.
Ol wak' cheklaj jun mach t'a norte, ol wawtejkot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ol yalan sb'a t'ayin. A' ol tek'anem heb' yajal, icha stek'ji lum sok'om yuj winh tz'akum lu'um, icha chi' ol aj heb'.

¿Tom ay junok ex ix eyalel yab'ixal jun tik t'a yiktax yichb'anel, yik skab' a onh tik? ¿Tom ay junok ex ayokto ix eyalankani, yik wach' skala' to yel tzeyala'? Malaj junok ex komon Dios ex tik ix eyal tas ol ujok chi', malaj anima ix ab'an eyalani.
Atax t'a yichb'anel, a in Jehová in tik ix wal jun ab'ix tik t'a Sion. Ha in ix in chekb'at jun in chekab' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at yal wach' ab'ix, to ol meltzajxok heb' anima t'a schonhab' chi'.
Tzin maklej wila'', tokwal ay junok komon Dios sjawi, malaj junok heb' syal yak'an in razón, malaj junok syal spakan tas tzin k'anb'ej.
Malaj junok heb' ay yelk'och jab'ok, malaj tas syal sb'oan heb', yuj chi' junelnhej malaj jab'ok yopisio juntzanh yechel b'ob'il chi', xchi Dios.
